LanguageData.RMFlow_TankModeDesc:
Click to change what this tank does on its pipes and hoses.

Store: holds liquid for pumps and machines.
Fill: pulls liquid from the other tanks into itself.
Empty: sends its liquid to the other tanks.
Dump: its liquid may leave through outflow hose ends or a pouring pump.

Tank to tank needs no pump.
LanguageData.RMFlow_TankJobsMessage: A hose between two tanks only connects them now. To move liquid between them, set one tank's job to Empty or Fill.
